name: Saimin Torotoro Operation ~Innai Bikyonyuu Hokan Keikaku~
original_name: 催眠とろとろオペレーション ～院内美巨乳補完計画～
source:
The protagonist is a psychiatrist.
Everyday, he is oppressed by the females in the hospital.
One day, he comes across a hypnosis technique.
Using this, he can do any to the ones who harass him, the mature director, the genius doctor, the cheerful nurse and the cheeky student.
And so, his lewd retaliation begins.

[Translated from [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/saimin/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名精神科医生。

他每天都受到医院女性的压迫。

一天，他接触到一种催眠技术。利用它，他可以对付那些欺负自己的人：成熟的院长、天才医生、开朗的护士，以及淘气的学生。

淫乱的报复就此开始。

[译自[url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/saimin/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
